name: azure-tts-plus
title: Azure Speech TTS+
description: Read the selected text aloud with Azure Neural voices or the built-in Windows engine — one hotkey to start and stop, live speed control, and a reader overlay that highlights each word as it is spoken.
author: luan_andrade

preferences.name: speechKey
preferences.title: Azure Speech Key
preferences.description: Your Azure Speech Service subscription key. Leave empty to use the built-in Windows voices only.
preferences.placeholder: Enter your Azure Speech subscription key

preferences.name: serviceRegion
preferences.title: Service Region
preferences.description: Azure service region (e.g. eastus2, westus, brazilsouth).

commands.name: speak
commands.title: Speak Selected Text
commands.subtitle: Azure Speech TTS+
commands.description: Read the selected text aloud. Run it again while it is speaking to stop.

commands.name: speed-up
commands.title: Speed up
commands.subtitle: Azure Speech TTS+
commands.description: Increase the speaking rate by 0.1x and keep reading from the current word.

commands.name: speed-down
commands.title: Slow Down
commands.subtitle: Azure Speech TTS+
commands.description: Decrease the speaking rate by 0.1x and keep reading from the current word.

commands.name: pause
commands.title: Pause or Resume
commands.subtitle: Azure Speech TTS+
commands.description: Pause the current reading, or resume it where it stopped.

commands.name: stop
commands.title: Stop Speaking
commands.subtitle: Azure Speech TTS+
commands.description: Stop the current reading and close the reader overlay.

commands.name: type-to-speak
commands.title: Type to Speak
commands.subtitle: Azure Speech TTS+
commands.description: Type a sentence and hear it right away.

commands.name: configure
commands.title: Configure Speech
commands.subtitle: Azure Speech TTS+
commands.description: Pick the engine, the voice, the speaking rate and the reader overlay.
